documents.title: Apple FY2023 excerpt
documents.text: Apple Inc. total net sales were $383.3 billion for fiscal 2023, compared with $394.3 billion for fiscal 2022. iPhone net sales were $200.6 billion. Services net sales were $85.2 billion. The company reported diluted earnings per share of $6.13.

documents.title: Microsoft FY2023 excerpt
documents.text: Microsoft Corporation revenue was $211.9 billion in fiscal year 2023. Operating income was $88.5 billion. Intelligent Cloud revenue was $87.9 billion. The company returned $18.1 billion to shareholders in dividends.
